[[No overall control]]{{efn|Conservative–Rochford District Residents–Independent coalition.}} | after_election = TBD | after_party = [[No overall control]] }} The '''2026 Rochford District Council election''' was held on 7 May 2026 to elect member of [[Rochford District Council]] in [[Essex]], [[England]].{{Cite web|title=Upcoming Elections|url=https://www.rochford.gov.uk/upcoming-elections|website=Rochford Council|date=2022-05-10|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en}} This will be on the same day as other [[2026 UK local elections|local elections]]. Due to ongoing [[Upcoming structural changes to local government in England|local government reorganisation]], this will be the final election to Rochford District Council before it is abolished and replaced by a successor [[unitary authority]]. Elections to the successor authority are due to take place in 2027. ==Summary== ===Background=== In [[2024 Rochford District Council election|2024]], the council remained under [[no overall control]].{{Cite web|title=Rochford local election results as council remains in political limbo|url=https://www.essexlive.news/news/essex-news/essex-local-elections-2024-rochford-9262798|website=Essex Live|date=2024-05-03|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en|first=Matt|last=Lee}} The [[Liberal Democrats (UK)|Liberal Democrats]] were the largest party.{{Cite news|title=Rochford result - Local Elections 2024|url=https://www.bbc.com/news/election/2024/england/councils/E07000075|work=BBC News|access-date=2026-01-30|language=en-GB}} === Council composition === {| class="wikitable" |- ! colspan="3" | After 2024 election ! colspan="3" | Before 2026 election |- ! colspan="2" | Party !
